parameters.name: outcoupling_coefficient
parameters.justification: Effective loss rate of guided light through the surface per unit path: silicone (n~1.41) against seawater (n~1.34) has a critical angle of ~72 deg, so ~70% of diffuse light escapes at each surface encounter; mu_out ~ 0.5*0.7/t = 700 1/m for t = 0.5 mm.

parameters.name: led_edge_fluence
parameters.justification: Fluence rate at the LED position, used as reference (normalised to 1); x runs from an LED (x=0) to the midpoint between two LEDs (x=1, symmetry).
